definition: TrackingBridge: every supported contingent truth at w has a reason at w. EvidenceBridge: every contingent truth used as evidence at w has a reason at w. GlobalDefeat: if a brute contingent truth exists at some world accessible from w, nothing supports anything at w. SupportCoverage: every contingent truth at w is supported at w. All four are hypotheses under test, and no result asserts any of them.
note: Analyst-stated for #756. Whether any source defends one of these forms has not been read; a sourced reading would need a pinned witness from the #409 intake.
